story.text: 스케줄이 모두 끝난 늦은 밤, 하늘은 텅 빈 공항 라운지에서 손님을 기다리고 있었다. 팬으로도, 기장으로도 아닌 그냥 자기 자신으로.
story.reading: seu-ke-jul-i mo-du kkeut-nan neuj-eun bam, ha-neul-eun teong bin gong-hang la-un-ji-e-seo son-nim-eul gi-da-ri-go iss-eoss-da. paen-eu-ro-do, gi-jang-eu-ro-do a-nin geu-nyang ja-gi ja-sin-eu-ro.
story.en: Late at night, once every schedule was finally done, Haneul waited in the empty airport lounge. Not as a fan, not as a captain — just as himself.

story.text: '…여기서 뭐 해요?' 손님이 놀라며 묻자, 하늘은 담담히 답했다. '그냥요. 아무도 없을 때 오면, 손님도 비밀 하나쯤은 편하게 말할 수 있을 것 같아서.'
story.reading: '…yeo-gi-seo mwo hae-yo?' son-nim-i nol-la-myeo mut-ja, ha-neul-eun dam-dam-hi dab-haess-da. 'geu-nyang-yo. a-mu-do eobs-eul ttae o-myeon, son-nim-do bi-mil ha-na-jjeum-eun pyeon-ha-ge mal-hal su iss-eul geot gat-a-seo.'
story.en: '...What are you doing here?' she asked, startled. Haneul answered calmly. 'No reason. I figured — if it's just us, with no one else around, maybe you could talk about a secret or two without it being hard.'

story.text: 나란히 앉은 두 사람 사이에 흐르는 침묵이, 이상하게도 편했다. 팬사인회도, 콘서트도 없는 그냥 평범한 밤이었다.
story.reading: na-ran-hi anj-eun du sa-ram sa-i-e heu-reu-neun chim-mug-i, i-sang-ha-ge-do pyeon-haess-da. paen-sa-in-hoe-do, kon-seo-teu-do eobs-neun geu-nyang pyeong-beom-han bam-i-eoss-da.
story.en: The silence between them, sitting side by side, felt strangely comfortable. No fan-signing, no concert — just an ordinary night, nothing more.

story.text: 손님이 조용히 물었다. '무대 위의 저랑, 지금 저랑… 어느 쪽이 더 좋아요?' 하늘은 잠시 고민하다 답했다. '그런 거 구분 안 해요. 둘 다 그냥, 진짜 당신이잖아요.'
story.reading: son-nim-i jo-yong-hi mul-eoss-da. 'mu-dae wi-ui jeo-rang, ji-geum jeo-rang… eo-neu jjog-i deo jo-a-yo?' ha-neul-eun jam-si go-min-ha-da dab-haess-da. 'geu-reon geo gu-bun an hae-yo. dul da geu-nyang, jin-jja dang-sin-i-jan-a-yo.'
story.en: She asked quietly. 'Which do you like more — me on stage, or me right now?' Haneul thought for a moment before answering. 'I don't separate those. Both are just — the real you, either way.'

story.text: '무대 위에서는 완벽해 보이려고 애쓰잖아요. 근데 지금처럼, 그대로 있는 것도 나쁘지 않아요. 오히려 더 좋아요.'
story.reading: 'mu-dae wi-e-seo-neun wan-byeog-hae bo-i-ryeo-go ae-sseu-jan-a-yo. geun-de ji-geum-cheo-reom, geu-dae-ro it-neun geot-do na-ppeu-ji anh-a-yo. o-hi-ryeo deo jo-a-yo.'
story.en: 'Up on that stage, you're always trying so hard to look flawless. But like this, right now — just as you are — isn't bad either. I actually like it better.'

story.text: 그 말에 손님의 눈이 살짝 붉어졌다. 어쩌면 그 짧은 한마디가, 수만 명의 함성보다 더 큰 위로였을지도 몰랐다.
story.reading: geu mal-e son-nim-ui nun-i sal-jjak bulg-eo-jyeoss-da. eo-jjeo-myeon geu jjalb-eun han-ma-di-ga, su-man myeong-ui ham-seong-bo-da deo keun wi-ro-yeoss-eul-ji-do mol-lass-da.
story.en: At those words, her eyes turned slightly red. Perhaps that one short sentence had been a bigger comfort to her than the roar of tens of thousands ever could be.

story.text: 라운지 창밖으로 활주로 불빛이 조용히 반짝였다. 두 사람은 한참을 그렇게, 아무 말 없이 나란히 앉아 있었다.
story.reading: la-un-ji chang-bakk-eu-ro hwal-ju-ro bul-bich-i jo-yong-hi ban-jjag-yeoss-da. du sa-ram-eun han-cham-eul geu-reoh-ge, a-mu mal eobs-i na-ran-hi anj-a iss-eoss-da.
story.en: Outside the lounge window, the runway lights blinked quietly in the dark. For a long while, the two of them just sat there, side by side, saying nothing at all.

words.example_en: Being together made him feel at ease.
Those words became a great comfort.

words.meaning: As is / just as you are
words.example_en: I like you just as you are right now.

sentences.en: This is the real you, isn't it.
That one sentence became a great comfort.
I like you just as you are right now.
